```yamlfile
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    tags: [v*]
  pull_request:
    branches: ['**']

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  java:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "! contains(toJSON(github.event.commits.*.message), '[skip ci]')"

    steps:

    - name: 1. Check out code
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'

    - name: 2. Set up Java for running Gradle build
      uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: 'zulu'
        java-version: 17
        cache: 'gradle'

    - name: 3. Validate Gradle wrapper
      uses: gradle/actions/wrapper-validation@v5

    - name: 4. Build and check reproducibility of artifacts (single job only)
      run: ./check_reproducibility.sh

    - name: 5. Spotless check (single job only). Run './gradlew spotlessApply' locally if this job fails.
      run: >
        ./gradlew
        spotlessCheck
        --stacktrace
        --scan

    - name: 6. Build on Java 11 with mock-maker-inline and member-accessor-module
      run: >
        ./gradlew
        -Pmockito.test.java=11
        build
        --stacktrace
        --scan
      env:
        MOCK_MAKER: mock-maker-inline
        MEMBER_ACCESSOR: member-accessor-module

    - name: 7. Generate coverage report
      run: >
        ./gradlew
        -Pmockito.test.java=11
        coverageReport
        --stacktrace
        --scan

    - name: 8. Upload coverage report
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
      env:
        CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
      with:
        files: mockito-core/build/reports/jacoco/mockitoCoverage/mockitoCoverage.xml
        fail_ci_if_error: true
```
